# btpservice_ctms_route (List Resource)

Discovers CTMS routes for import. Filters use exact matches and are evaluated locally with AND semantics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "btpservice_ctms_route" "example" {
  provider         = btpservice
  include_resource = true

  config {
    name = "DEVELOPMENT_TO_QUALITY"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Exact route name.
- `source_node_id` (String) Exact source node ID.
- `target_node_id` (String) Exact target node ID.
